product_one_liner.value: Aviatrix provides cloud networking and network security for enterprise cloud, networking, and security teams, enabling consistent connectivity, visibility, and workload communication controls across multiple clouds.

employee_band.notes: The company profile accompanying the posting reports 418 employees.

eng_blog.notes: Two Tech Deep Dive posts explain the data-plane architecture and SmartGroups implementation; both are authored by Tim McConnaughy, identified as a Technical Marketing Engineer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No listed job title contains the specified AI/ML/data-science terms. Distinguished Engineer involves AI development in its description, but its advertised title does not meet the requested title test.

model_provider.notes: Aviatrix explicitly says its Secure Network Supervisor Agent is powered by Microsoft Security Copilot; the announcement does not identify a specific underlying model.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the requested labels listed under Audits and Certifications in the Trust Center; GDPR is a compliance framework rather than a formal certification.
